description: This file defines the AdoNetBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for the Orleans streaming framework using ADO.NET. It manages serialization, deserialization, and event handling for batch containers in a database context.

classes.name: AdoNetBatchContainer
classes.description: An internal class implementing IBatchContainer for ADO.NET provider, supporting binary serialization and event batching for Orleans streams.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, and request context.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specified type, associating them with sequence tokens.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into the current context if available.

methods.name: FromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AdoNetBatchContainer instance from a serialized message.

methods.name: ToMessagePayload
methods.description: Serializes the batch container into a byte array for message transmission.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container.
